title: Concept: Crate marked unpublishable
description: Cargo.toml declares a `publish = false` crate that other projects may still path-depend on, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `publish = false` crate that other projects may still path-depend on.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `publish = false` crate that other projects may still path-depend on.
